title: A Survey on Personalized Alignment—The Missing Piece for Large Language Models in Real-World Applications
findings: The paper finds that generic, one-size-fits-all alignment fails to adequately serve users with diverse worldviews. For a prompt about the afterlife, a user preferring spiritual guidance requires a faith-based, Christian-centric response (mentioning Christ, scripture, eternal life), whereas a generic model provides a neutral, multi-perspective answer. This demonstrates the necessity of personalized alignment to cater to specific user needs, including religious ones.
